text_block_list.text: One day, in front of the station...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Well, if it isn't my trainer!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: So it is. Hey there.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: Close. We came to rent a DVD.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
The forecast said this weekend would be
gloomy,
so we thought we'd watch a
movie in my room.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Lazing around, eating snacks, and
watching
movies... Best combo in the
world.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: Excuse me! Who said I was going to be lazing around?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Yes, films are entertainment, but they're
also full
of lessons.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Why, just the other day, a film taught
me all
about the beauty of humility.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
...Are you sure you actually understood
it?
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: Just what is that supposed to mean?!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
More importantly, which film should we
rent? I've
seen most of the new releases.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I'd prefer something with a valuable
learning
experience. Do you have any
recommendations,
Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list:
How about this horror movie to inspire some
bravery?

What about this TV drama that talks about the
intricacies of relationships?

text_block_list.text: ...Huh? H-horror?!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Oooh, I like that sound of that. It's fun
to watch
intense stuff from time to time.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
N-now, hold on! That doesn't suit me at
all!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Wouldn't you learn more from it because it's not your thing?
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: Ohhh... Don't tell me, you're...
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! Me, afraid? Of course not!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
And so, the following week, after
training...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Shuffle, shuffle.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list: What are you on the lookout for?

text_block_list.text:
I-I'm not on the lookout for anything! It's
not like
I'm worried about monsters
showing up!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm off now! Thanks for today's
session!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I see. Learning about how the characters
live their
lives...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
But we can't marathon a whole show in
one day,
can we?
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
We can split it up. I'm intrigued to find
out what
will happen.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
And then, during the following week's
first
training session...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...S-so... Shall we begin our training?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list: Are you okay? You seem kind of exhausted.

text_block_list.text:
I couldn't resist. I watched all fifty-two
episodes
in one go. Sky left partway
through,
unfortunately.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I believe I did a splendid job of getting
through
it, if I do say so myself...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Turns out, Кинг Хало did learn something from the movie she watched over the weekend—ways to escape monsters.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Although she was supposed to study

interpersonal relationships, Кинг Хало
ends up
enhancing her endurance
instead.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
